title: Edit another user's crontab
summary: Use sudo to edit the crontab of a different user on the system.

steps.explain: Edit the crontab for a specific user. Replace <USERNAME> with the target user's name.

placeholders.name: USERNAME
placeholders.description: The username whose crontab you want to edit.

rollback.explain: There is no automatic rollback. You must manually revert changes in the editor.

warnings: Editing another user's crontab requires root privileges. Be careful not to break system tasks if editing root's crontab.
